notes:
Inbound SMB lead via Shopify listing. Team: CTO (Asha Rao), Lead Dev (Calvin Park), merch manager (Renee). Primary ask: chat-like product Q&A widget on product pages + nightly catalog enrichment (attributes, alt-text, categories). Traffic: normal day 300–800 uniques; big sale windows spike 15x for 2–6 hours.

Customer comments / call highlights:
- 'We need product answers that feel natural — 90% of queries are sizing, materials, care instructions.'
- Wants <200ms token generation on product pages (front-end perceived latency). Will accept streaming solution.
- Cost is sensitive: monthly dev budget for API ~ $800–1,200 to start.

Technical notes / constraints:
- Catalog: ~6k SKUs, product descriptions vary — many missing structured attributes.
- Prefer hosted for now; no VPC/on-prem. Ok with public cloud region (us-east).
- Auth: currently API key for prototypes; will want org SSO later but not blocking initial POC.
- Concern: burst pricing and 429s during flash sales. Asked about auto-throttling and retry/fallback patterns.

Suggested Redwood talking points shared to customer:
- Recommend hosted_api with streaming + prefix/KV caching for product Q&A; separate embeddings job nightly for catalog enrichment.
- Suggest conservative batching and adaptive concurrency for sale spikes; point to Optimize suggestions later.
- Provided sample pricing scenarios and estimated cost for 6k SKU nightly enrichment (doc attached).

Next steps (short):
- Send integration guide + sample mapping sheet (done 2026-03-05).
- POC: integrate chat widget on 1 category page, run enrichment on 1k SKUs overnight, monitor latency/cost. Target demo 2026-03-10.

Stated blockers: budget cap, clarity on burst SLA and retry semantics. SE (Maya) to validate expected concurrency and propose rate-limit policy.
